title: Create a tar archive of files or folders
summary: Bundle multiple files or directories into a single .tar file. You can also create compressed archives (.tar.gz or .tar.xz) to save space.

steps.explain: Create a standard uncompressed .tar archive containing the specified files or directories.

placeholders.name: TARGET_ARCHIVE
placeholders.description: The name of the new archive file to create (e.g., backup.tar)

placeholders.name: FILES_OR_DIRS
placeholders.description: The files or directories to include in the archive

alternatives.explain: Create a gzip-compressed .tar.gz archive, which is smaller and faster to transfer.

placeholders.name: TARGET_ARCHIVE
placeholders.description: The name of the new archive file to create (e.g., backup.tar.gz)

placeholders.name: FILES_OR_DIRS
placeholders.description: The files or directories to include in the archive

alternatives.explain: Create a compressed archive using the extension to determine the compression method (e.g., .tar.xz for xz compression).
